jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Consumers Energy is Michigan’s largest energy provider, providing natural gas and/or electricity to 6.8 million of the state’s 10 million residents in all 68 Lower Peninsula counties. Consumers Energy knows job number one is to keep the lights on for customers. We are committed to delivering reliable, clean, and affordable energy to our customers 24/7.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, e.g., H-1B, TN, etc. Please do not apply if you will need immigration sponsorship for a work visa now or in the future, including sponsorship for H-1B, TN, etc., now or in the future. We are unable to hire individuals with CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT for this position as the position is not eligible for participation in the H-1B lottery program and is not eligible for current or future immigration sponsorship for a work visa.

Location : This is a hybrid (virtual/onsite) position with required onsite days on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday and may be assigned to any Consumers Energy Service Center located throughout Michigan's lower Peninsula.  The selected candidate must be within a commutable distance or willing to relocate (relocation package is available for those that qualify).

GENERAL SUMMARY OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
The Regulatory Compliance Analyst will use detailed program management expertise to provide program and process support for compliance requirements and regulatory standards. Research, analyze, select, and apply program management concepts, approaches, techniques, and criteria to ensure compliance requirements are met; engage in industry discussions and forums to help steer the development of new and modifications to existing regulatory requirements; research testing and control methods used at Consumers Energy sites to ensure they are within regulatory standards. Familiarity with the techniques and concepts of compliance program detective, preventive, and corrective actions and controls is required.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist business unit subject matter experts with interpretations of the relevant NERC standards.
Assess business unit processes to determine if they satisfy the relevant regulations (NERC Standards, etc.) and, if not, recommend and oversee improvements to achieve compliance.
Contribute to the development of procedures that specify the standard work required to satisfy each NERC requirement.
Engage in discussions and forums to help steer regulatory compliance standards development and modifications to existing standards.
Manage and lead assigned compliance continuous improvement projects, as needed or directed.
Monitor and respond to federal and industry-level alerts and inquiries regarding the company's compliance programs.
Perform other duties as assigned or as necessary.
Perform risk control activities and review program procedures to identify gaps and update processes. Suggest and help implement process improvements and waste elimination initiatives.
Responsible for monitoring public utility commissions, industry events, and trends for changes in regulatory policies and procedures that could impact compliance with utility rate case filings, regulated program offerings, business practices, or other regulatory strategies.
Responsible for reviewing compliance evidence and documentation for accuracy and regulatory adherence. Develop action plans and risk controls to ensure regulatory objectives are met within established deadlines.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES
Skill in analyzing and organizing technical data.
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, tasks, and assignments.
Understanding and familiarity with each regulation under purview and the ability to oversee the development of procedures that specify the standard work required to satisfy each NERC requirement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop documentation for regulatory processes and procedures.
Possess sufficient familiarity with business processes to guide business unit subject matter experts toward compliant behavior.
Ability to maintain a safe, secure, and healthy environment by adhering to organizational standards, policies, and legal regulations; alerting others to potential concerns.
Ability to analyze processes and implement improvements through data analysis and control design.
Knowledge of regulatory laws and organizational structure, with skills and knowledge specifically applicable to the energy and utility industry.
Ability to perform compliance assessments that result in desired outcomes through effective controls and adherence to requirements.
Ability to analyze and interpret complex information, conduct research, and manage highly confidential and time-sensitive matters.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Political Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, with two (2) or more years of experience in compliance, risk management, auditing, and a strong utility operations background. Experience creating reports, learning new technology, change management, and data analysis. Experience managing technical cross-functional programs. For T&E and Operations: Experience in the operation, design, manufacturing, and/or repair of transmission and distribution electrical equipment or electrical systems. (Required)

(OR) Associate's degree with four (4) or more years of experience in compliance, risk management, auditing, and a strong utility operations background. Experience creating reports, learning new technology, change management, and data analysis. Experience managing technical cross-functional programs. For T&E and Operations: Experience in the operation, design, manufacturing, and/or repair of transmission and distribution electrical equipment or electrical systems. (Required)

(OR) High School Diploma/GED with six (6) or more years of experience in compliance, risk management, auditing, and a strong utility operations background. Experience creating reports, learning new technology, change management, and data analysis. Experience managing technical cross-functional programs. For T&E and Operations: Experience in the operation, design, manufacturing, and/or repair of transmission and distribution electrical equipment or electrical systems. (Required)

Why should you join our team?

At Consumers Energy, we offer more than just a place to work. We foster a culture that supports career development, growth, and stability, and we take pride in offering our co-workers excellent benefits and compensation packages. We are deliberately creating an inclusive culture that makes our diverse team of co-workers feel valued, supported, and empowered every day. We're a company made up of thousands of people, all with different stories to share and work to do, but we stand united in our company purpose: world class performance delivering hometown service.

What we offer:

- Competitive compensation packages

- Medical, Dental and Vision

- 401k with company match

- Paid parental leave

- Up to 13 paid Holidays

- Paid time off

- Educational Assistance Program

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion:

We, at CMS Energy, value Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion. It is part of our DNA. We treat our employees with respect, we treat each other fairly and we value the opinions of others. We are passionate about building and nurturing an environment where everyone feels included. We don’t discriminate. We seek to learn about each other and better understand our unique differences. Our uniqueness makes us authentic. We create safe spaces where everyone can be who they truly are. We invite difficult conversations and uncomfortable topics. We value diverse perspectives; this is what makes us great together. We harbor an inclusive environment where employees feel empowered to share their backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. Our Employee Resource Groups, Women in Energy (WE), Minority Advisory Panel (MAP), Pride Alliance of Consumers Energy (PACE), GENERGY (Different Generations), capable (Different Abilities), Interfaith, People Planet Partners, and Veterans Advisory Panel (VAP) are key enablers to living the values of our company culture: Caring, Empowered, Deliberate, Agility, and Ownership.

All qualified applicants will not be discriminated against and will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability, race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

Intern Role Summary

The Data Visualization Intern will support Learning & Development by collecting and organizing data, creating clear visualizations, and improving reporting or work processes. The role requires someone who can work independently, manage changing priorities, collaborate with technical and nontechnical partners, and translate data into useful information that helps the team identify successes, gaps, and opportunities.

Skills and Capabilities Needed

- Data visualization and analysis: Ability to turn data into dashboards, reports, or visuals that communicate performance, gaps, trends, and opportunities.

- Technical aptitude: Familiarity with tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, or similar data and automation technologies.

- Data collection and metric tracking: Ability to gather reliable information, define and monitor important measures, and provide regular progress updates.

- Organization and time management: Ability to prioritize competing tasks, overcome access or resource barriers, and keep work moving.

- Communication: Clear, concise communication; active listening; and the ability to explain technical information to nontechnical audiences and confirm understanding.

- Customer focus and collaboration: Ability to clarify needs, set realistic expectations, negotiate alternatives, and maintain productive working relationships.

- Adaptability and change management: Comfort working through shifting requirements, feedback, project bottlenecks, and changing customer needs.

- Problem-solving and process improvement: Initiative to identify ineffective processes, investigate root causes, troubleshoot issues, and recommend practical improvements.

- Professional presence: Curiosity, accountability, openness to different perspectives, and the confidence to ask questions and seek support when needed.

What the Intern Would Do

- Collect, clean, organize, and validate L&D data from available systems and stakeholders.

- Develop and maintain dashboards, visual reports, and automated reporting solutions that make key metrics easy to understand and use.

- Partner with L&D, data, and IT contacts to obtain access, clarify requirements, and resolve data or technical issues.

- Track project measures and provide routine progress updates through check-ins and other agreed-upon communication.

- Translate customer needs into practical data solutions, explain constraints, and recommend alternatives when a request cannot be completed as proposed.

- Incorporate feedback and adjust deliverables as project needs evolve.

- Identify reporting or workflow inefficiencies and help test, troubleshoot, and implement improvements.

- Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Education

- Currently enrolled and actively pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in the Data Analytics, Finance, Business or related field

- The minimum GPA of 3.0 or higher.
